title: Auto Cast
description:
SpellsUnlock and master various self casting spells with unique talents and masteries to slay the horde of never ending enemies!BossesIf the hordes weren’t enough, your increase in power attracts formidable foes. These bosses will way the hero down with powerful debuffs, dispatch them quickly, before you become overwhelmed.ItemsIn efforts to aid your journey, chests with build defining items have been scattered across the lands. Anvils can also be found and used to forge ancient relics, which can be activated for boosts in power.TalentsDefeating bosses garners the attention of Soul Forgers who will mend the hero’s fragmented soul and grant boons, but beware, the being that stole it in the first place still roams the lands.UnlocksFailure is still progress towards success. Unlock new spells, items, and more as you gain prestige. Coins can also be spent in the shop to boost the hero’s power, or to further line your pockets.

Can you make it past level 35?
description_short: Auto Cast combines elements from action rogue-likes, RPGs, and Shoot 'Em Ups into a 2D top-down world. Unlock new spells, level up existing ones, equip unique items, and find special events to maximize your chances of survival while cutting through hordes of enemies and bosses.
